Understanding Pension Reform

The government announced major changes to the pension system in 2024. Citizens born after 1970 will see their retirement age raised to 65.

Key Changes

  • Retirement age increased to 65 for those born after 1970
  • Early retirement option available from age 60 with reduced benefits
  • Minimum contribution period extended from 15 to 20 years

Impact Assessment

An estimated 2.3 million workers will be affected by these changes. The reform is expected to save 1.4 billion euros annually by 2030.
